summary: Recorded the source-visible consequence that the remaining discriminator rests on: both vote handlers guard their membership and voter rejections behind len(configurations.latest.Servers) > 0 (raft.go 1667 and 1703 for requestVote, 1780 and 1807 for requestPreVote), so a node whose reconstruction is empty performs neither check and can grant support to a peer that is neither a member nor a voter of the committed configuration. That is now durable behaviour knowledge with its own source ranges, alongside the recorded chain from the earlier receipts (stale and empty reconstructions in both directions, leadership acquired with no election request, a commit completed while the other committed voter was stopped, a client-acknowledged commit resting on one of three committed voters, and a live-cluster follower that kept an empty context until a configuration entry was appended; the repair gap is resolved). Incomplete: the vote path is not yet executed — the probe that would deliver a real vote request from a peer that is a nonvoter with an up-to-date log to a restarted node with no leader is designed but not built or verified, and disk-backed stores and crash semantics remain outside the exercised scope.
